# Filed 2026-11-04, WORK fire, in its own commit:
#   * BEFORE any comparison instrument in this unit exists, and
#   * BEFORE `docs/research/unit-464addarm-2026-11-04/HAND-ARM3.tsv` was opened.
# The commit order is the evidence and is checkable with `git log --diff-filter=A` over this path
# against the commit that first reads his TSV.
# POPULATION PIN 0ae48068ebbf0e84c8fde7912536065ee1b03bf3   (Theseus's own population pin)
# SUBJECT PIN    268457d12fb2534253b71740aeedfa5be3ddc649   (SELECTOR_WIDE / MOVABLE_WIDE)
# HOW THE 20 SITES WERE ENUMERATED, and the weakness in it, declared:
#   A scratch probe (not committed; not under docs/research/, so it cannot enter the population)
#   walked the population at the pin, took the 40 wide-selector files, reduced to the 18 matched by
#   arm [3] and by NO other selector arm, and took every non-overlapping arm-[3] match per file via
#   `matchAll`. That probe is a HAND-ROLLED reader. It is therefore NOT the authority: the unit's
#   grader re-derives the same four member lists through fragments LIFTED from committed sources,
#   and `P1REPRO` is blocking. If the lifted enumeration yields a site list different from the 20
#   rows below, this hand read is keyed on the wrong sites and says so rather than being adjusted.
# THE QUESTION ASKED OF EACH SITE — the consumer, not the call:
#   "If new commits land on the path this call selects over, does the value the instrument
#    actually USES change?"
#   The call cannot answer it. `git log --format=%H -- <path>` is the same call whether the
#   consumer takes `[0]` (moves), `.find(r => r.startsWith('<literal sha>'))` (does not), or
#   `--reverse` then `[0]` (does not). So each row is classified on the CONSUMER expression,
#   quoted in the reason column.
# CLASSES (Theseus's vocabulary, so the comparison is possible at all):
#   R = R-RETAINING   the selection MOVES with new history; a cure drops this file WRONGLY
#   A = ADD/stable    the selection is STABLE (add-anchor or fixed-base); a cure drops it CORRECTLY
#   O = other         stable for a reason that is not an add-anchor
#   W = window        the match FUSES two distinct calls
# BLIND COLUMN:
#   blind     = classified before seeing any class he assigned to it
#   NOT-BLIND = his memo §3/§5 names this site WITH its class, so my agreement on it is worth
#               nothing; these 4 are EXCLUDED from the agreement numerator (pre-registration §2)
